changes.oldText: Superadmins can manage model cards through the Model Store Management tab on the Admin Deployments page.
changes.newText: Superadmins can manage model cards through the Model Store Management tab on the Admin Deployments page. The list shows the model cards of your current domain, and new model cards are created in that domain's Model Store project.
